card.name: Taxonomic and kinship comparisons before 'affinity'
card.fires_on: Words in natural-history or classification text where a comparison of relatedness is under way, such as counts of plant families, 'same families, genera', or 'resemblance to'. The next word is likely 'affinity' or 'affiliation'.

modes.label: Counts of plant families
modes.description: Numbers and 'of' in lists of how many families of plants a survey found.

modes.label: Resemblance between fossils or groups
modes.description: Words in geology and biology passages that describe likeness between faunas, beds or species.
modes.example: they belong to the<< same>> families, genera, and sections of genera

modes.label: Language and people families
modes.description: Words naming a family of peoples or languages, or an origin.

card.writes: It promotes 'aff', 'affili' and 'affiliation' and suppresses 'cl' pieces, so it pushes toward words like 'affinity' or 'affiliated'.
card.plain: It fires in biology and classification text about how related groups are, where a word like 'affinity' may come next.
